company_description:
Corvale Mobility is a privately held, Kraków-headquartered transportation and technology company providing intercity bus and passenger-rail travel in Central Europe. Its asset-light model relies on regional partners to operate many routes, while Corvale manages the booking platform, network planning and brand. It is expanding its rail service and prioritising data and machine learning across its platform.

Founded and still led by transport and software specialists, Corvale describes itself as technology-first and engineering-led. Its international teams own systems end to end and work collaboratively to solve problems. The company emphasises sustainability, innovation, professional development and individual career ownership.

Its stated values are **Lead, Shape, Own and Enjoy the journey**. Employees describe the culture as collaborative, fast-moving and open to new ideas. Corvale has received workplace culture awards based on anonymous employee feedback, including recognition for work-life flexibility, purpose and values, development and appreciation. Employees can work hybrid and receive travel benefits, while many technology roles are also open to independent contractors.

results.title: About Corvale Mobility
results.content: Corvale Mobility runs long-distance buses and a growing passenger-rail service in Central Europe. It uses an asset-light model: regional partners operate many routes while Corvale runs the booking platform, network planning and brand. Corvale has ordered a new train fleet to enter service later this decade, and scaling data and machine-learning use across the platform is a strategic priority.
